text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap has asked me to visit a shrine
with her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've been feeling kind of sluggish lately.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I keep making small mistakes in
everything I do. I
just don't feel like
myself...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Masa always used to say, "In troubling
times, ask
the divine."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, praying at the shrine
at my
hometown's racecourse seemed to
work. It even
helped me win a race or
two.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've decided to ask the gods
for help.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You will? Thanks. I really appreciate it.
choice_data_list: 一緒に神様にお願いするよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll pray to the gods with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and I pray together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I left an offering as well, so I hope our
prayers are
answered...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's a coupon for a free extra
serving of
ramen! The gods sure are
quick to listen!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think they're telling me to stuff my face
with
ramen for a boost of energy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I feel better already. All right, let's go
get some
ramen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Armed with the answer to her prayers,
Oguri Cap
happily skips down the road
as we head off to
enjoy some ramen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I let such a great coupon go to waste... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't seem like a good sign of
things to
come...
